panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 8 panels (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H). A: Clinical photograph of the patient's thickened lips, a characteristic MEN2B manifestation. B: Clinical oral photograph shows arrow-marked mucosal neuromas, a classic and highly specific MEN2B manifestation. C: The photograph visibly demonstrates thyroid-region enlargement in a patient with MEN2B. Microcalcifications are not directly assessable in this clinical photograph, so the broader thyroid finding is placed in proposed findings rather than overasserting the full vocabulary label. D: Ultrasound shows multiple abnormal lymph nodes, explicitly captioned as metastatic lymph nodes in this MEN2B case. The finding is retained as a proposed term because the vocabulary lacks metastatic lymph nodes. E: Thyroid ultrasound demonstrates a calcified thyroid mass corresponding to the MEN2B-associated medullary thyroid carcinoma phenotype described in the caption. F: Axial CT visibly shows marked dilation of the colon, a recognized...

The physical examination also revealed multiple painless, firm nodules on her gingival tissue, tongue and buccal mucosa, and these were considered mucosal neuromas (Fig. 1 a, b). Her thyroid was enlarged, and multiple hard nodules could be palpable on the surface of the thyroid (Fig. 1 c). There was no palpable mass in her abdomen. Fig. 1Clinical Characteristics of the Patient (a) Thickened lips. (b) Neuromas affecting the gingival tissue, tongue and oral mucosa (as yellow arrows indiated). (c) Thyroid nodule. (d) Multiple metastatic lymph nodes .(e) Thyroid enlar

Two masses were found in each lobe of her thyroid along with multiple metastatic lymph nodes by ultrasound (Fig. 1 d). The size of the right mass was 37 mm × 20 mm and that of the left mass was 43 mm × 20 mm (Fig. 1 e). Both masses were classified as Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System (TI-RADS) 5. The abdominal X-ray and CT scan revealed transverse colonic dilatation and colonic wall thickening (Fig. 1 f, g, h), which suggested a diagnosis of megacolon. There were no obvious abnormalities in her head MRI or adrenal CT scan.
